verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe configuring automatic fallback across models/providers on the Universal endpoint, including error/timeout triggers, chained fallback sequences (e.g., Workers AI → OpenAI), and a response header (cf-aig-step) indicating which fallback step succeeded. This directly matches the story of platform engineers configuring automatic fallback to another model/provider on failure. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation beyond vendor docs.
